title: Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells Preparation
author: John Davis Coakley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6zyhf7w
materials: Layer this diluted blood onto 10mls Lymphoprep TM
Discard the plasma and obtain the buffy coat

steps.title: Dilute Whole Blood
steps.instruction: Dilute whole blood 1:1 with 1% FCS HBSS Medium.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the diluted blood for 25 minutes at 400G with acceleration and brake off.

steps.title: First Buffy Coat Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the buffy coat using 1% FCS.

substeps.instruction: Top up buffy coat with 1% FCS
Centrifuge for 8 minutes at 1500RPM with brake on

steps.title: Second Buffy Coat Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash of the buffy coat using 1% FCS.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 8 minutes at 1500RPM with brake on

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 4-5mls of RPMI and vortex.

steps.title: Count Live Cells
steps.instruction: Determine the live cell count using a haemocytometer slide.

substeps.instruction: Stain cells with ethidium bromide (to detect dead cells) and acridine orange solution (to detect live cells)
Count cells using the haemocytometer slide
